title: 我对科学与技术的思考(My Thoughts on science and technology)
summary: 说话者表达对科学与技术的观察与思考。

sentences.en: I have just started learning English on my own.
sentences.zh: 我刚开自学英语。

sentences.en: Max believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
sentences.zh: 马克斯相信尝试新事物让生活保持新鲜。

sentences.en: At first, Max found it difficult to keep the habit.
sentences.zh: 起初,马克斯觉得很难坚持这个习惯。

sentences.en: They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
sentences.zh: 他们无话不谈,从功课聊到未来的梦想。

sentences.en: There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
sentences.zh: 路还很长,但方向是对的。

sentences.en: I usually spend my weekend at the museum reading or taking notes.
sentences.zh: 我周末通常在博物馆阅读或记笔记。

sentences.en: I am planning to travel to Rome with my family in February.
sentences.zh: 我打算二月和家人去罗马旅行。

sentences.en: Nanotechnology coats the fabric in silica.
sentences.zh: 纳米技术给织物镀上二氧化硅。

sentences.en: Online shopping saves weekday evenings.
sentences.zh: 网购省去了工作日晚上的时间。

title: 讨论校园生活(Discussing school life)
summary: 两人就校园生活深入交流,互相给出建议。

sentences.en: Good to see you, Grace. How is everything going?
sentences.zh: 见到你真好,格蕾丝。最近怎么样?

sentences.en: How do you manage your time between study and hobbies?
sentences.zh: 你怎么安排学习和爱好的时间?

sentences.en: I have practiced baseball for three years, but I still feel nervous before matches.
sentences.zh: 我练棒球已经三年,但赛前还是会紧张。

sentences.en: I am planning to travel to Paris with my family in March.
sentences.zh: 我打算三月和家人去巴黎旅行。

sentences.en: My dream is to work as a teacher in the future.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是将来当老师。

sentences.en: That makes sense. Thanks for sharing.
sentences.zh: 有道理,谢谢你分享。

sentences.en: For example, his viva lasted ninety minutes.
sentences.zh: 他的口试持续了九十分钟。

sentences.en: Best of all, cramming the night before rarely works.
sentences.zh: 考前一晚突击很少管用。

sentences.en: Wish me luck! I will tell you how it goes.
sentences.zh: 祝我好运!我会告诉你结果的。
